method: Built-in image_gen style-transfer from approved vegetable heroes; one output per asset, with two portrait framing refinements. Exact generated PNG bytes copied to the project.

assets.name: Roots & leaves — beetroot
assets.description: A broad, low triangular harvest group of two rounded deep burgundy beetroots with reddish stalks and green leaves, three slender orange carrots, and three small red-and-white radishes. The beetroot anchors the left foreground; carrot leaves sweep gently upwards to the right. A loose lively grouping, 4:3 landscape composition. No cabbage, onion, tomato or pea. This is variation A1 of a ROOTS & LEAVES header pair.
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: transparent vegetable illustration for the same book as the approved hero references.
Primary request: redraw the target with EXACTLY the drawing language of the approved hero references. The user likes the subject and arrangement but rejects the target's increase in naturalistic detail.

Match the references' large rhythmic tapered cream highlight slashes and occasional scalloped highlight strips. Use a few broad tones per form. Leaves use a bold midrib and just a few broad vein branches. Keep broad characteristic lobes. Avoid realistic gloss, photographic materials, 3D rendering, brush texture, black outlines, tiny repeated details.
Genuinely transparent background; clean solid interior colour, no green glow or colour haze outside the silhouettes, no cast shadow or ground. Whole illustration inside canvas with clear space around every tip. One illustration only; no sheet, panels, text, labels, signature or border.

Keep the target's broad landscape harvest group: two burgundy beetroots at left, three orange carrots sweeping diagonally through the middle, three small red-and-white radishes at right, with foliage rising behind. Use the exact bold simplified carrot foliage shapes and beetroot/radish shading language of images 1–3, as if that same illustrator drew this group. Simplify roots to clean tapered tips without hairs. Keep the target's distinct composition. 4:3 landscape.

revisions.prompt:
